description: EXPERIMENTAL: written from Datadog's documented API and tested against recorded and mock responses, not yet against a real Datadog, so it may not work as is. Reads logs, metrics and monitors, read-only. Off until an environment sets it up.

apiKey.description: A Datadog API key (Organization Settings > API Keys)

appKey.description: A Datadog application key with read scopes (logs_read_data, timeseries_query, monitors_read)

site.description: Your Datadog site: datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu, us3.datadoghq.com, us5.datadoghq.com, ap1.datadoghq.com ...

baseUrl.description: Replaces https://api.<site>: for a proxy, or the demo's fake Datadog

searchLogs.description: Search the logs of Datadog with its query syntax (service:payments status:error @order:4512), oldest first, with their times. Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Datadog.

query.description: Datadog log query, e.g. service:payments status:error, or @order:4512 for an attribute

from.description: Start: ISO 8601 or relative like now-15m (default now-1h)

limit.description: Most logs to return, up to 100

newest.description: Newest first instead of oldest first

queryMetric.description: Query a Datadog metric over a time range, as points with their times, e.g. avg:payment_confirm_queue_depth{env:prod}. Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Datadog.

query.description: Datadog metric query: aggregation:metric{scope}, e.g. avg:system.cpu.user{service:shop}

from.description: Start: ISO 8601 or relative like now-1h (default now-1h)

monitors.description: The monitors of Datadog and their state (Alert, Warn, No Data, OK), optionally filtered by name or tag: what is alerting. Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Datadog.
